chapterFiles.title: Luke 21 — The Lukan Olivet Discourse: the widow's mite + the destruction of the Temple + the cosmic-signs in sun, moon, stars + the Son of Man coming in a cloud

versionSource: Best-effort reconstruction from earliest-attested Koine Greek uncial codices: Codex Vaticanus (B/03) + Codex Sinaiticus (א/01) + early papyri cross-collation + NA28/UBS5/SBLGNT critical apparatus
sourceCitation: Codex Vaticanus (B/03; Vatican Library Gr. 1209, 4th c. CE) + Codex Sinaiticus (א/01; British Library Add. 43725 et al., 4th c. CE) as primary uncial witnesses. Cross-collation against P45 (Chester Beatty I, ~250 CE) for Mark/Acts; P75 (Bodmer XIV-XV, ~175-225 CE) for Luke; P47 (Chester Beatty III, ~250 CE) for Revelation. Critical apparatus: NA28 (Nestle-Aland 28th, 2012); UBS5 (United Bible Societies 5th, 2014); SBLGNT (SBL 2010); THGNT (Tyndale House 2017). Commentary references vary by book — see per-book documentation.

subtitles.en: Luke 21 — the Lukan Olivet Discourse (cosmic-signs in sun, moon, stars; the Son of Man coming in a cloud)

descriptions.en: Luke 21 from the earliest substantial Koine Greek manuscript witnesses (Codex Vaticanus + Codex Sinaiticus + P75 Bodmer XIV-XV, the earliest substantial Luke witness, ~175-225 CE, contains complete Luke). The Lukan Olivet Discourse includes the cosmic-signs reading at Luke 21:25-26 (signs in sun, moon, stars; distress of nations; men's hearts failing them for fear) — engaged by the Raëlian canon as one of the cosmic-signs sites.
